incidents.name: We are experiencing issues with logging in to Teamwork Projects in our US region
incidents.message: Teamwork Projects in our US region is operating normally now. A database received and high level of traffic for a short time causing performance issues for existing users

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users unable to log in to Teamwork Chat in our US region
incidents.message: Chat logins were impacted for a moment while a Redis cache was completing maintenance.

incidents.name: Desk Inbox counts currently unavailable in our US region
We are investigating reports of Projects not loading correctly in our EU region
incidents.message: Projects are loading successfully in our EU region now. Some maintenance overnight used up more memory on a Redis cache, preventing our API from adding new data for a short time.

incidents.name: Slow response times for Teamwork Desk US region
incidents.message: The source of the degraded performance impacting some of our customers hosted in the US has been identified and resolved.

incidents.name: Slow response time for Teamwork Projects in our US region
incidents.message: Replica lag on a small number of replicas has now been resolved and enabled in Production again

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of issues logging in to Chat in our EU region
incidents.message: Chat EU is responding normally again after restarting Chat services

incidents.name: Kubernetes patch upgrade in our EU region
incidents.message: The upgrade of our EU Kubernetes cluster has been completed.

incidents.name: We are currently investigating reports of users unable to log in to Chat US region
incidents.message: Logins are back to normal now, a redis cluster required some work in our US region as it was running out of memory with the current load.

incidents.name: We are currently experiencing issues with Projects in our US region
incidents.message: Projects database issues in the US have been resolved.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Multi product database maintenance - EU region
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: [Scheduled] Multi product database maintenance - US region
incidents.message: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of users being unable to log in on their first attempts
incidents.message: Logins are operating normally now, a small number of services required a restart after a Redis node failed over

incidents.name: We are investigating reports of erros on logs ins to Chat US region
incidents.message: Chat logins in the US region are pressing well again.

incidents.name: We are currently working on reported issues of failed / looping log in attempts
incidents.message: We have rolled back a change to our log in process which stored session data and caused some users to get caught in a looping log in process.

incidents.name: Slow load on Teamwork Desk
incidents.message: Teamwork Desk in our US region is responding normally again after a period of high load on a database

incidents.name: Custom domains with HTTPS offline in our US region
incidents.message: Custom domains with HTTPS are operating normally in our US region again

incidents.name: Slow down in Teamwork Chat EU
incidents.message: Teamwork Chat in our EU region has returned to normal now.
